
```{python}
import pandas as pd
import os

back_dir = os.path.normpath(os.getcwd() + os.sep + os.pardir)
df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(back_dir,'outputs','mistral_appended_names.csv'))
print(df.columns)

df['Mistral_scientific_name'] = df['Mistral_scientific_name'].map(lambda x: x.strip())

def count_words(string):
    string = string.strip()
    ls = string.split(' ')
    return len(ls)

df['words_in_name'] = df['Mistral_scientific_name'].map(lambda x: count_words(x))

```

```{python}
df.groupby('words_in_name')['words_in_name'].count()
```


```{python}
names_redo = df[(df['words_in_name']!=2) & (df['words_in_name']!=1)]
print(names_redo.shape)
print(names_redo['Mistral_scientific_name'].head())
```

# Saving in reprocessing directory
```{python}
save_path = os.path.join(back_dir,'outputs','reprocessing','names_to_reprocess.csv')
names_redo.to_csv(save_path,index=False)
```
